evidence: The Order constructor checks that the id and customer id are present, that there is at least one line, and that each quantity is a positive integer. It throws DomainError when a check fails, which is a domain invariant.
Order.advance() uses canTransition from the domain to enforce the order status state machine.
Order.cancel() holds the business rule that an order that is already cancelled, shipped or delivered cannot be cancelled.
The only imports are ./errors and ./order-status, both in the domain layer. There is no database, HTTP or framework code.
